en.title: meloxicam tablets: Highlights, Dosage and Administration and 2.4 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Highlights, Dosage and Administration reads “7.5 mg/kg once daily in children ≥60 kg”. 2.4 reads “7.5 mg once daily in children who weigh ≥60 kg”. Example: For a child of 60 kg, Highlights read literally gives 7.5 mg per kg (450 mg a day); section 2.4 gives 7.5 mg. The same text is in 4 labels from 2 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: high. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
